title: CDI - Senior Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
description:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

 

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients. For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.
 What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.
   Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.
 The team We are a mission-driven team of 80 engineers based in London and the surrounding areas, united by the challenge of fixing healthcare communication. We are innovating for the NHS at a scale and depth that has never been done before, solving the real-world problems that stand between millions of patients and the care they need.
 We are a highly cross-functional group where engineering, product, data, and security collaborate as true peers. We foster a low-ego, high-impact environment that values expertise and new ideas, maintaining the high standards required to build and scale a national healthcare communication platform. Within this ecosystem, our teams operate with high autonomy, owning everything from initial system design to long-term service stability.
 As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of our Data Engineering, Product, and BI teams, expanding our data modelling and self-serve capabilities, and building the foundations that turn data from a support function into a strategic asset.

title: Finance Data Engineer
description:
About Voodoo Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.
 Team Our Corporate teams support the company's performance and growth whilst putting people at the core of everything they do. As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Corporate teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organisation efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. Voodoo's Corporate function is composed of three teams: HR, Legal and Finance, working together to drive Voodoo's success.
 As Voodoo continues to grow, we are transforming the way Finance uses data and technology. Our ambition is to move from fragmented, spreadsheet-heavy workflows to a modern, reliable, and increasingly automated Finance data platform.
   Role We're looking for a Finance Data Engineer to join our Corporate team. In this role, you'll own the technical transformation of Finance by building the data foundations, pipelines, and internal tools that enable Finance teams to operate more efficiently and make better decisions.
 Reporting to the CFO, you will work closely with Finance stakeholders and Voodoo's central Data team, combining data engineering, business understanding, and product thinking to turn complex Finance needs into reliable and maintainable solutions.
 Define and drive the roadmap for Finance data, automation, and internal tooling
 Build and progressively scale Voodoo's Finance data platform, prioritising the use cases that create the greatest business value
 Migrate critical data transformations and workflows from spreadsheets and legacy tools to tested, documented, code-based solutions

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
Who is Sonar?
 Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.
Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.
 Position description:
 We want to make the best decisions possible for our products and to do that, we need to make data-driven decisions.
 To achieve this goal, we are looking for a talented Data Engineer - you! - to join the Data & ML Platform team.
 Together, we will make Sonar’s products the undisputed world-leading code remediation solution!
 What you will do
 You will design and develop the data platform to support the functional domains in handling their data and help them in their journey to data ownership. This means:
 Design and implement data storage, transformation, and load capabilities of our pipelines.
 Continuously enhance the data platform. Propose, implement and manage data handling services according to stakeholders needs (Product Managers, Marketing, Sales, engineering teams, ...)
 Establish top-class end-to-end pipelines including data cleaning and modelling.
 Develop and deploy connectors to data sources of interest.
 Maintain evergreen data flow documentation across systems.

title: Senior Data Engineer, Cloudforce One
description:
About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
 Available Locations: London, UK
 About the role
 Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). title: Senior Data Engineer Tech Foundations
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations
 The Community You Will Join
 At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.
 Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.
 You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.
 The Difference You Will Make
 As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.
 You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations. Working closely with stakeholders and engin…

title: Sales Compensation Systems & Data Engineer
location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose: economic empowerment. We build technology that increases access and independence for sellers, individuals, and artists around the world. Working at Block means working on and across our brands—Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Spiral, and Proto— in roles that connect, enable, and push all of them forward faster.
 We’re remote-first by design and operate with intelligence at the center of everything we do. At Block, you'll be challenged by some of the brightest, most creative minds in the industry and have the tools and autonomy to do the most meaningful work of your career.
 The Role
 We’re looking for a hands-on Sales Compensation Systems & Data Engineer to build and maintain the technical foundation of our sales compensation operations. You’ll own data pipelines, integrations, data models, and calculation logic that produce accurate, reliable, and explainable commission results.
 You’ll partner with Sales Compensation Operations, Finance, Payroll, and technical teams to translate approved compensation plans and business requirements into tested, maintainable systems.
 You Will
 Lead technical design and implementation of commission-related systems, integrations, and data flows across sales, finance, and payroll.
 Build and maintain pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data used in commission calculations and payments.
 Design data models supporting sales crediting, participant eligibility, plan versions, effective dates, adjustments, and historical traceability.
 Translate approved compensation plans into maintainable calculation logic and platform configurations. Identify ambiguous requirements and work with business owners to confirm and document approved interpretations before implementation.
 Build automated tests covering calculations, integrations, plan changes, edge cases, and regression scenarios.

title: Data Engineer, Marketplace
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Here at Lyft, data is at the core of every decision we make. It powers our business — helping us create great transportation experiences for our customers and providing insights into the effectiveness of our product launches and features.
 As a Data Engineer on Lyft’s Marketplace – Decision Apps team, you will own and evolve the data pipelines that power our top-line financial, pricing, and driver-related metrics. You will collaborate with Analytics, Data Science, and Engineering partners to design data models and architectures — proposing innovative ideas, evaluating multiple approaches, and implementing solutions grounded in fundamental engineering principles and rigorous data analysis. Your work will provide seamless access to the insights that drive Lyft’s success.
 Responsibilities:
 Take ownership of core data pipelines, ensuring resilience, optimal performance, timely delivery, data quality, and seamless onboarding of new features
 Continuously evolve data models and schemas to meet business and engineering requirements
 Implement and maintain systems to monitor and enhance data quality and consistency
 Develop tools that support self-service management of data pipelines (ETL) and perform SQL tuning to optimize data processing performance

 Conduct code reviews to uphold code quality standards and facilitate knowledge sharing
 Participate in on-call rotations to maintain high availability and reliability of workflows and data pipelines
 Collaborate with internal and external partners to remove blockers, provide support, and achieve results

title: Staff Data Engineer, Advanced Insights & Modeling
location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.
 The Role
 The Advanced Insights and Modeling (AIM) team is a high-impact, business-savvy group of builders: machine learning engineers, data scientists, data engineers, and business strategists who combine technical skills with deep product and financial expertise. We hold high standards, move fast, and own our models end to end. AIM runs on curiosity, bold thinking, and collaboration, and we keep the culture decidedly non-corporate. Teams across Block come to us when they need insight, speed, and real business impact.
 AIM sits within Block’s Foundational organization and is sponsored directly by the CFO, but our mandate runs well beyond Finance. We own most of the measurement and predictive modeling at Block: forecasting across Cash App, Square, and Afterpay, customer lifetime value, marketing incrementality and spend optimization, sales pipeline and prospect value, and actives and network-effect measurement.
